title: Chat/changes and Message/changes silently ignore maxChanges
description: Chat/changes (chat.rs:413) and Message/changes (message.rs:696) hardcode hasMoreChanges:false and return all changes regardless of any maxChanges argument. RFC 8620 §5.6: if maxChanges is provided, the server must not return more than that many changes. A JMAP client that sends maxChanges:5 to either endpoint receives all N changes with no pagination signal — a protocol violation. Newly-fixed Contact/changes (which correctly implements maxChanges) creates a visible behavioral inconsistency between sibling endpoints. At Phase 1 volumes this won't manifest, but any client exercising the standard JMAP changes-loop will be broken if message or chat counts grow.
